bio.text: Brad Little has been Idaho's 33rd Governor since January 7, 2019, according to the governor's office.

According to the governor's office biography, he is an Emmett native raised on his family's sheep and cattle ranching operation, and he graduated from the University of Idaho in 1977 with a Bachelor of Science in Agribusiness.

The same biography says he first served in public office in 2001 when he was selected to fill an Idaho Senate vacancy, was then elected to four consecutive terms, and became Lieutenant Governor on January 6, 2009.
